I have not figured out why it happened.  In the mean time, could you please let us know your gcc version and make version. 

Also from a terminal you can try the following, which might be helpful for us to figure out.  Suppose you have a very simple cpp file as follows.

$ more a.cpp
int foo() {
  return 1;
}

Then you do R CMD SHLIB on the cpp file. 


$ R CMD SHLIB a.cpp
